sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Sanjay Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Alok Agnihotri - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.35/2023 registered at Police Station-Lanjhi, District- Balaghat (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 21(1), 21(2), 21(3) of the Unregulated Deposit Scheme Banning Act, 2019 and Sections 420, 406, 120- B of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Applicant is in jail since 12.08.2024.
It is submitted that charge sheet has been filed and investigation is complete.

Applicant is ready to deposit the defalcated amount i.e.
Rs.4,37,500/- (Rs.Four Lac Thirty Seven Thousand Five Hundred Only) before trial Court/CJM under protest.
In these circumstances, he prayed that applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:55362 2 MCRC-41687-2024 application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that a racket is being operated in Balaghat by which people are being duped and cheated of their money by giving them false inducement of doubling the money.
In these circumstances, application for grant of bail deserves to be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application stands allowed on following conditions :-
